notes: Official Mad Mex Australia Nutritional Calculator page, with page metadata showing modified 2026-05-27.
Meal totals are calculated from official per-serving calculator attributes by adding the menu item's default ingredients to the selected vegetarian filling.

Vegetarian suitability is taken from the calculator's Vegetarian filter data, which includes Mexicali Mince, Veggie Veracruz, black beans, cheese, queso, sour cream, guacamole, and the listed meal formats.
Default recipes use Mild Salsa (Fire-Roasted Tomato). Salsa swaps, removing cheese or sour cream, adding guacamole, and extra portions will change the totals.
The calculator publishes per-100 g and per-serving macros but does not expose serving weights in grams in the page markup used here.
Quesadilla is omitted even though its visible ingredients look meat-free, because the official Vegetarian filter did not include QUESADILLA in its vegetarian product list.

Add-ons are included only where the official calculator has numeric per-serving macros and the item is a useful vegetarian protein extra; low-protein extras such as guacamole, vegan cheese, and Veggie Veracruz are omitted from add_ons.
